subject: Technical deep dive: ML & infra agenda + scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Brooks <jamie.b@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.r@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Post-discovery: propose ML/infra technical deep dive (60-90 min)

Hi Jamie -

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Goals you called out: reduce inference latency for clinical summarization, ensure PHI-safe routing for sensitive requests, and predictable unit economics for 24/7 workloads.
- Primary success metric: p95 latency < 300ms for summary generation at peak load; secondary: <20% token cost reduction targets after caching/quantization.

Next step: you mentioned bringing your ML + infra team together for a 60-90 minute technical deep dive. Proposed agenda (attached as PDF):
1) 10m introductions & goals
2) 15m summary of current infra and model stack (your side)
3) 30-40m Redwood architecture deep dive (serving runtime, KV/prefix caching, quantization profiles, routing/fallbacks)
4) 20m integration discussion (auth, VPC/private deployment options, monitoring/trace hooks)
5) 10m open Q&A + next steps

Availability: we can do next week on any of the following (all in PST):
- Tue 2026-07-07 10:00-11:30
- Wed 2026-07-08 14:00-15:30
- Thu 2026-07-09 09:00-10:30

Please let me know which slot works and who from your team will attend (ML engineers, infra, security). I'll loop in our ML infra engineers (Dylan + Vivek) and send a calendar invite + agenda doc.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.c@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
